profile.name: Raj Shah
profile.tagline: Production AI / ML Engineer building reliable, evaluation-driven AI systems.
profile.specialization: Production ML Systems · RAG · Evaluation · Deployment
profile.bio: Computer Science + Data Science graduate from Rutgers University. I build AI systems that combine deterministic validation, retrieval grounding, scalable pipelines, and LLM-assisted reasoning.

experience.summary: Built production-oriented geospatial ML pipelines for subsurface exploration and multimodal data fusion, focusing on preprocessing, validation, evaluation, and batch inference workflows.
highlights: Built an end-to-end ML pipeline classifying lithology across 4 geological datasets, achieving ~68% accuracy.
Standardized multi-source datasets using Pandas and Parquet, reducing preprocessing errors by ~20%.
Engineered preprocessing and validation workflows to improve data quality across dynamic batch prediction inputs.
Developed batch inference pipeline with predict_proba confidence scoring for dynamic prediction inputs.

experience.summary: Delivered stakeholder-facing analytics with validated datasets, ETL workflows, optimized SQL, and Tableau dashboards.
highlights: Cleaned and validated 1,500+ records using SQL and Python, improving data accuracy by ~25%.
Developed ETL workflows for transformation, reducing manual reporting time by ~25% overall.
Built Tableau dashboards for 100+ stakeholders, improving KPI reporting efficiency by ~25%.
Optimized SQL aggregation/filtering queries to improve retrieval efficiency and processing speed.

projects.title: RU-PATH: AI-Powered Campus Parking & Transit Chatbot
projects.subtitle: RAG + deterministic validation + multi-engine routing
projects.description: Built a RAG-based AI assistant for Rutgers campus navigation, parking, and transit queries using authoritative datasets, retrieval grounding, and deterministic validation logic. Implemented semantic search + NLU intent routing across chatbot, parking logic, and routing engines, exposed via Flask REST APIs, and deployed with Docker + GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Decoding the Fed: NLP-Based Yield Prediction
projects.subtitle: FinBERT + TF-IDF drift + walk-forward validation
projects.description: Built a finance-focused NLP pipeline using 189 FOMC statements and Treasury yield data (1994–2024). Extracted sentiment/policy signals using TF-IDF drift analysis, FinBERT embeddings, and hawkish/dovish lexicons before training Random Forest, Lasso, Ridge, Logistic Regression, and XGBoost with walk-forward validation to reduce time-series leakage.

projects.title: Automated Data Collection & Analysis Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Python + SQL analytics pipeline with validation
projects.description: Built an automated Python + SQL analytics pipeline that reduced manual preprocessing time by ~80%, enforced validation checks, and generated Tableau-ready outputs for 100+ stakeholders.

projects.title: Evac AI — AI Disaster Response Platform
projects.subtitle: FastAPI backend + risk scoring + real-time integrations
projects.description: Built a FastAPI backend integrating weather, alerts, geolocation, and AI evacuation workflows. Developed a risk scoring pipeline using live weather/disaster alerts and nearby resources, and connected iOS and web applications via modular REST APIs for scalable disaster response support.
